name: RR Financial Consultants Limited
about: RR Financial Consultants Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides financial services in India. The company offers mutual funds, fixed deposits, initial public offerings, wealth management products, and retail bonds; valuation for perquisites taxation, regulatory valuations, valuation for shares of closely held companies, and valuation of ESOP for accounting and other purposes; mergers and acquisitions, corporate finance, primary debt markets, project finance and advisory, private equity advisory, research, restructuring advisory, and risk management services; and insurance services comprising health, property, liability, motor, fire, unit linked, life, marine, accident, casualty, vehicle, and travel. It also provides stock broking, commodity futures, commodity spots, currency futures, depository services, and interest rate futures. In addition, the company offers investment banking services; and operates in various activities, such as distribution of financial products, insurance brokers, broker of financial products, and related activities. The company serves participant, corporate houses, institutions, banks, asset management companies, and investors. RR Financial Consultants Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
